money_at_stake.rationale: Anchored on the Panama Canal Authority's FY2025 results, the one pool this occurrence is verifiably reshaping. The Authority's own release (pancanal.com) states total revenues of 'B/.5.705 million', up 14.4% from 'B/.4.986 million' in FY2024, naming the container and LPG segments as growth drivers, i.e. the exact traffic this candidate is about. That literal wording is almost certainly a scale error on the official page: the balboa is pegged 1:1 to the US dollar, and a figure of roughly USD 5.7 million is two orders of magnitude below the canal's known scale and inconsistent with every other account of the same fiscal year. A dedicated gCaptain report on the same release states the scale unambiguously ('revenues rose around 14.4% in its fiscal year 2025 to $5.7 billion', same growth rate, same period), and a separate gCaptain report on the year's treasury transfer independently states 'total revenues rose approximately 14.4% to $5.7 billion.' Taking the corroborated USD 5.7bn figure, that places the band at B1_10, comfortably clear of the B10_100 threshold. Record 2026 transit fees (a single Neopanamax walk-up slot hit USD 4.6 million in August 2026) show this same pool still growing past the FY2025 print, but there is no dated figure taking it past USD 10bn this fiscal year. Deliberately NOT combined with broader US petroleum-gas or LNG export trade-value statistics found in general search (tens of billions each): those price the underlying commodity cargo, not the toll and routing spend this specific congestion occurrence is moving, and stacking incompatible pools would manufacture a precision none of the sources supports. VERIFICATION PASS 2026-08-30: all four URLs below were fetched fresh this run. Every claim and every excerpt below is the actual page text; the 'B/.5.705 million' wording, the two independent USD 5.7bn corroborations, and the USD 4.6 million fee figure all confirmed exactly as written. No change to band or figures.

public_reach.rationale: This is the finding. The one pool this appraisal can size, the Authority's FY2025 toll revenue (see money_at_stake), is captured entirely by the Panama Canal Authority, a Panamanian state entity, and the Authority's own reporting shows USD 2.965bn of it moving straight to Panama's National Treasury rather than to any listed issuer. The named companies actually touching this occurrence so far sit on the cost side, not the fee-capture side: Chevron Corp is named executing ship-to-ship LPG transfers off Balboa specifically to manage record transit fees (Energy Connects), and separately TotalEnergies SE is named as the charterer of both supertankers, the Panamax Energia Grandeur and the Neopanamax Eneos Wisdom, conducting an unusual ship-to-ship transfer off Balboa, with MOL Energia Pte. (owner/manager of Energia Grandeur) and a stake held by Eneos Holdings Inc. in the ship manager of Eneos Wisdom also named (gCaptain/Bloomberg). All four are listed, but the money in this appraisal's evidence base flows out of them toward the canal authority, not into them. Not scored lower than 25 because a real second-order listed pool exists one layer down: Clarksons-reported VLGC spot earnings hit nearly USD 170,000 a day in May 2026, the highest on record for that route, and a material share of the global VLGC fleet sits on public balance sheets. No source found ties a specific named listed owner's results to this exact episode with a dated figure, so that reach is inferred rather than evidenced, which is exactly what a chain build would need to establish. capture_odds.rationale: Genuinely two-sided. For capture: the Panama Canal is a hard chokepoint with no equivalent-speed substitute, and that scarcity is visibly pricing today, with VLGC spot earnings on the Houston-Chiba route hitting nearly USD 170,000 a day in May 2026, the highest ever recorded for that data series, per Clarksons Research. Against capture: the same congestion that creates the premium is actively teaching shippers to route around the canal and around the fee entirely, which is the classic mechanism that competes a chokepoint premium away rather than the mechanism (qualification, patent, regulatory license) that usually locks one in. The clearest evidence of that erosion already inside this dataset is operational, not just directional: exporters including a major listed oil company are restructuring their supply chain (ship-to-ship transfers at Balboa) for the specific purpose of avoiding the premium rather than paying it, which is demand actively exiting the priced chokepoint. Scored at the middle anchor rather than rounded toward either story, the same shape as the precedent LEAKY appraisal on this stage. timing_fit.rationale: The money is moving now, not projected into a future window. Record transit fees, the record VLGC freight print, and the ship-to-ship workaround are all dated inside a single window running from May through August 2026, and the structural driver behind the canal-side restriction risk, El Nino, is forecast by NOAA at a 63% probability of becoming 'very strong' during November-January, potentially among the strongest since records began in 1950, with the Panama Canal Authority already cutting its Neopanamax draft limit from 50 feet to 49.5 feet tropical fresh water effective July 3, citing concerns about El Nino development and rainfall uncertainty. Congestion itself is real and dated but moderate: a maximum wait of 8 days northbound and 4 days southbound for the 14 ships without advance bookings against 115 scheduled to transit, attributed to Iran-war-related traffic diversion plus canal authorities tightening restrictions amid El Nino-driven drought conditions, heaviest on the Neopanamax vessels that ferry LPG from the US Gulf Coast to Asia. That supports 'credible and largely committed inside the window' alongside the record-fee and record-freight evidence, but the moderate (not extreme) congestion severity keeps the score below the 85+ anchor. This CAND record carries no formal occurrence.window field the way a promoted signal card would, so this score is anchored on the record's own date field (2026-08-29) and on the evidence's own dating rather than an invented window; flagged in notes below for reconciliation if this candidate is promoted.
